title: Reading Drill — Planning for Snow on a Footbridge
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Planning for Snow on a Footbridge
passages.body:
**A** A council reviewed a bridge where pedestrians reported slippery decking. The first reports named the bridge but did not say whether the problem occurred in a shaded section.

**B** The council asked a caretaker to note conditions at both ends on early mornings. Frost remained longer near a nearby wall, even after the sun reached the other end.

**C** The caretaker began clearing the slower section first. The council also tested whether a textured surface could improve grip without making the boards hard to clean.

questions.prompt: The first reports named the bridge but did not say whether the problem occurred in a ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The first reports named the bridge but did not say whether the problem occurred in a shaded section.

questions.prompt: Frost remained longer near a nearby wall, even after the ______ reached the other end.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Frost remained longer near a nearby wall, even after the sun reached the other end.

questions.prompt: The council also tested whether a textured ______ could improve grip without making the boards hard to clean.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The council also tested whether a textured surface could improve grip without making the boards hard to clean.

questions.prompt: The bridge had been closed for a previous winter.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage does not state this information.
